title: David vs. Goliath: Maryville Esports Takes on Korea’s Greatest Team Ever Assembled
summary: David vs. Goliath: Maryville Esports Takes on Korea’s Greatest Team Ever Assembled  Maryville University
content:
Threeindividualswill step onto one of the biggest stages in the history of competitive gaming. On Saturday, September 19, JunHao“AoJune“Chen, Jeremiah “ScaryJerry“Leathe, and Ryan “Zyko” Jung will wear the red, white, and blue in an internationalLeague of Legends(LoL)showdown against South Korea’s national teaminafriendly.

This isn’t just any roster; it’s a Maryville reunion on the international stage:

2,500 fans packed into the stunning Busan Cinema Center, the electric atmosphere of a Korean esports crowd, and a broadcast beamed exclusively on Disney+ across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The match will be hosted by the Korea e-Sports Association (KeSPA), which invited the United States as one of just two international opponents alongside Vietnam to sharpen its squad for the Asian Games. KeSPA is rolling out the red carpet, covering housing, meals, ground transportation, and practice facilities for the entire delegation.

This tier-two, semi-pro roster was assembled by Nick “Inero” Smith, head coach of the USA Esports LoL program and a veteran of the North American professional scene. He’ll be joined on the bench by Aiden “Niles” Tidwell, Maryville’s head LoL coach, traveling with the delegation to assist the coaching staff. Dan Clerke, national team manager for USA Esports, andMaryville University’s director of esports,is coordinating the entire operation. While North America’s top league sits in the middle of its playoffs and couldn’t release its players, the door swung open and Maryville’s finest walked through.

“Being a part of this means the world to me,” said Aiden Tidwell. “I love my country, so having the chance torepresentthem is something I will always cherish. Also, playing against some of the greatest players of all time makes this a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity —we’llmake the most of this trip.”
